name: Tsukimori Kyou
source:
A magical girl who goes by the name "Embrace."
She lives in the same dorm as Yumeha and is also her classmate.

Her personality is best described as cool-headed—or perhaps just overly serious.
But it’s not that she’s a stick-in-the-mud or a bookworm. Rather, she carries the weight of a painful parting from her past—something that shaped her deeply.


"Sure, maybe I can’t do this alone...
But you were blessed and born to fulfill others’ hopes too, weren’t you—
Magical Girl Empress!"
